analogy.rationale: Glucosamine synthetase stimulation increases hexosamine flux and UDP-GlcNAc, a metabolic/nutrient-sensing signal rather than a canonical receptor pathway; the closest reference classes are other carbohydrate/lipid metabolic modulators, but transcriptional responses in these cell lines are likely weak and non-specific.
